items.x: Horror con Spooky Empire, much like a good slasher-flick villain, is back for another installment in Orlando on Halloween weekend.

items.t: Organist Cameron Carpenter conjures symphony of horror to soundtrack ‘Nosferatu’
items.x: Between the haunting shadows of Murnau’s Nosferatu and Carpenter’s esoteric accompaniment, this silent film promises to make plenty of noise.

items.t: The Nook celebrates its last night open with a Halloween funeral party
items.x: The Nook on Robinson is closing on Halloween night and, fittingly for a space that has never shied away from a good conceptual soiree, with a funeral-themed party.

items.t: Orlando musicians dress up as their fav bands for Halloween cover shows
items.x: The local institution that is Psycho ’78 doing their annual full-bore Misfits set is always welcome; a GG Allin tribute act called GG Ellin has us intrigued despite ourselves; and hardcore firebrands M.A.C.E. doing a Bauhaus (!) tribute…

items.t: Humanitarian aid set to enter Oleshky as a rare Russia-Ukraine truce holds for a third day
items.x: A Ukrainian official says that humanitarian aid is set to arrive in the stricken Russian-occupied city of Oleshky on Friday, as a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine stretches into its third day.

items.x: A man who fled from deputies was taken into custody Wednesday night near the entrance of the Canaveral National Seashore, according to the Volusia Sheriff's Office.

items.t: China's record-breaking exports of clean tech are making a big dent in emissions, report says

items.t: Weblinks
Ship sinks off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast after being hit by drones
items.x: A Liberian-flagged vessel that was hit by drones off Bulgaria’s Black Sea coast has sunk, the local maritime administration said on Thursday.

items.t: Dollars & Sense: America’s storage unit obsession
items.x: From furniture we no longer use to boxes we haven’t opened in years, millions of us are paying monthly rent for possessions we no longer have room for in our everyday lives.
